Corollary
[compact manifolds are metrically complete]

Source: petersen:page-0198 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-metric-topology

1. ch5:5.3.9If $M$ is compact and $g$ a Riemannian metric on $M$, then $(M,|\cdot |_g)$ is a complete metric space.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch5-compact-complete-metric

\sketch By section 3, the distance topology is the compact manifold topology. Every compact metric space is complete.

□
